purpose: Teach: 一式/公文書/リーク/プロファイル/新旧/未完成/偏向/覆す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品の、本気で、絶対、一式、絶対、揃えろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need a complete new product lineup assembled. This is serious—make it happen.
lines.style: Sharp, decisive opening. Direct eye contact. Measured pace with weight on each clause. No softening. The tone of someone accustomed to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、公文書、絶対、保管、絶対、厳重に、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're treating all company documents with strict confidentiality protocols. Rest assured.
lines.style: Calm, professional cadence. Each phrase measured and deliberate. Slightly formal register. The careful precision of someone confirming critical details back to leadership.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合への、本気で、絶対、リーク、絶対、無いよう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ensure there are no leaks to competitors. I want this locked down completely.
lines.style: Firm, no-nonsense. Slight pause after 'competitors.' Lower register on the final clause. The implicit threat beneath the reasonable words.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の、本気で、絶対、プロファイル、絶対、最新化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Our client profiles are being updated to current specifications as we speak.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact delivery. Light emphasis on 'current' to signal progress. Respectful but not deferential. The tone of a competent subordinate confirming execution.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 設備の、本気で、絶対、新旧、絶対、入れ替え、絶対、計画、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: The equipment replacement plan is moving forward. I want the timeline accelerated.
lines.style: Controlled intensity. Brief pause mid-sentence for emphasis. Slightly elevated on 'accelerated.' The voice of someone not tolerating delay.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。試作品、本気で、絶対、未完成、絶対、部分、絶対、調整、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Confirmed. We're finalizing the remaining prototype adjustments. Progress is on track.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring tone. Slight lift on 'finalizing' to convey confidence. Even pacing throughout. The voice of someone reporting genuine progress to someone expecting it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: メディアの、本気で、絶対、偏向、絶対、報道、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Monitor the media landscape carefully. I need visibility on any biased coverage.
lines.style: Controlled alertness. Slight lean forward on 'carefully.' Lower register at the end. The cadence of someone aware of external threats and delegating surveillance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、業績、絶対、業界の予想を、絶対、覆す、絶対、勢いです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Confirmed. Our performance metrics are already exceeding industry projections. We're building momentum.
lines.style: Measured confidence building toward the end. Slight emphasis on 'exceeding.' Warmer than previous responses but still formal. The voice of someone delivering good news to leadership.
